name: Tinker - Mech (V)
description: (Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. With resources, knowledge, and time, create your dream Mecha to shame Gundams, antimatter-powered Hadron cannons, planet-sized spacefaring mechs with Death Star cannons. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.
